title: Regular ordinary pullback with fibrewise pinnings
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, $n\geq1$, $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z$, and let $h:Y\to X$ be a regular morphism between Noetherian excellent schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-exc-excellent-ring]. Regular means flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] with geometrically regular fibres: every field extension of a residue field gives a regular fibre [def-weil-regular-scheme, def-pc-scheme-fibre]. Let $\delta_X$ be a dimension function and $K\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ a pinned potential dualizing complex [def-per-potential-dualizing-complex]. Set
$$c_h(y)=\dim\mathcal O_{Y_{h(y)},y},\qquad \delta_h(y)=\delta_X(h(y))-c_h(y),$$
where the dimension is the Krull dimension of the local ring [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Then $\delta_h$ is a dimension function, and $h^*K$ has potential pinnings for $\delta_h$. The pinnings are the following fibrewise ones. After localization of $X$ at $x=h(y)$, write $i:Y_x\hookrightarrow Y\times_X\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{X,x}$ and $q:Y_x\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(x)$. The supported base-change comparison identifies $i^!h^*K$ with $q^*R\Gamma_xK$; apply the pinning of $K$ at $x$, and then the inverse absolute-purity class at $y$ on the regular fibre $Y_x$. Thus the resulting costalk is $\Lambda(\delta_X(x)-c_h(y))[2\delta_X(x)-2c_h(y)]$. These constructions are natural in pinning-preserving maps of $K$, restrict to open subsets, and respect composition of regular morphisms. No finite-type or perfect-field assumption on $h$ is imposed.
